title: 第002章 全村嘲讽无缘道，一身琴艺踏仙途
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

眩晕控场的效果持续三息。

短短三息时间，对于旁人不过转瞬即逝，可对于被定身的王桂香来说，却漫长又诡异到极致。

她意识完全清醒，听觉、视觉、感知全部在线，偏偏身体分毫动弹不得，手脚僵硬、声带锁死，连眨一下眼、喘一口大气都做不到。

那种浑身被无形力量禁锢、彻底失控的恐慌，瞬间席卷了她的全身。

心底疯狂翻涌着惊惧和诡异，脑子里一片空白，完全想不通到底发生了什么。

明明只是要踹死一个废物侄女，怎么突然就动不了了？！

三息转瞬即逝。

“嗡——”

无形音波之力消散殆尽，眩晕状态解除。

王桂香身体猛地一颤，浑身瞬间恢复知觉，却因为保持姿势太久，腿脚一软，直接重重踉跄着摔坐在黄泥地上！

“哎哟！！”

尾椎骨狠狠着地！

剧痛传来，她忍不住发出一声凄厉惨叫，整个人又惊又怒，后背惊出一层密密麻麻的冷汗。

刚才那一瞬间的诡异禁锢，太吓人，太邪门了！

她猛地抬头，死死盯着眼前安然站立、眼神清澈平静的蔡小姬，心底莫名升起一股从未有过的忌惮。

眼前这死丫头……好像哪里不一样了？

往日的怯懦、卑微、躲闪、畏畏缩缩尽数消失不见。

此刻的少女身形纤细单薄，衣衫破旧，依旧是那副人人鄙夷的废柴模样。

可眼神澄澈镇定，脊背挺直，不见半分卑微怯懦，安静地站在那里，竟莫名让人不敢轻视。

王桂香心头惊疑不定，可多年欺压养成的蛮横戾气压过了恐惧。

一个天生废柴、任人拿捏的孤女而已！

就算突然邪门了一点，还能翻了天不成？

“你个死丫头片子刚才对我做了什么？！”

王桂香色厉内荏地嘶吼，撑着地面爬起来，指着蔡文姬的鼻子怒骂：

“反了你了！一个吃我家饭、住我家屋的白眼狼，居然敢装神弄鬼吓唬长辈啦？！”

“我看你是活腻了！今天宗门选拔你不去正好！我现在就打死你这个废物扔乱葬岗，省得以后留在家里碍眼！”

骂完，她再次张牙舞爪扑上来，抬手就要狠狠撕扯蔡文姬的脸。

在她眼里，这死丫头就是装神弄鬼、故弄玄虚，必须狠狠打服，才能继续任由她们夫妻拿捏欺压。

可此刻的蔡文姬，早已不是从前任打任骂的懦弱孤女。

她微微侧身，轻松躲开对方疯扑的动作，身形轻盈灵巧，完全不似常年劳作、体弱多病的农家少女。

同时心念微动，不再轻易控人伤人，只催动一丝微弱的治愈之力，落在王桂香身上。

【思无邪】轻微净化debuff。

王桂香常年心思恶毒、戾气缠身、心性阴狭，身上藏着一身浊气、躁气、恶气。

蔡文姬的治愈音波自带净化扶正之力。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The effect of dizziness and field control lasts for three breaths.

The short period of three breaths was fleeting to others, but to Wang Guixiang who was immobilized, it was long and extremely weird.

She was completely conscious, and her hearing, vision, and perception were all online. However, her body could not move at all, her hands and feet were stiff, her vocal cords were locked, and she could not even blink or take a breath.

The panic of being imprisoned by invisible forces and completely out of control swept through her body in an instant.

Fear and weirdness surged crazily in my heart, my mind went blank, and I couldn't figure out what was going on.

He obviously just wanted to kick his useless niece to death, why could he suddenly not move?!

Three breaths are fleeting.

"Buzz——"

The power of the invisible sound waves dissipated completely, and the dizzy state was lifted.

Wang Guixiang's body trembled suddenly, and she regained consciousness instantly. However, because she maintained her posture for too long, her legs and feet went weak, and she stumbled heavily and fell to the yellow mud ground!

"Ouch!!"

The tailbone hits the ground hard!

The severe pain came, and she couldn't help but let out a shrill scream. Her whole body was shocked and angry, and a dense layer of cold sweat broke out on her back.

The weird confinement just now was so scary and evil!

She raised her head suddenly and stared at Cai Xiaoji, who was standing safely in front of her with clear and calm eyes. She felt an inexplicable fear in her heart that she had never felt before.

This damn girl in front of me... seems to be different?

The cowardice, humility, avoidance, and timidity of the past have all disappeared.

The girl at this moment was slender and thin, her clothes were shabby, and she still looked like the loser that everyone despised.

But his eyes were clear and calm, his back was straight, and he was not a bit humble or cowardly. He stood there quietly, which somehow made people dare not look down upon him.

Wang Guixiang was frightened and confused, but the arrogance and cruelty developed from years of oppression overcame her fear.

Just an orphan girl who was born useless and allowed to be manipulated by others!

Even if you suddenly become a little evil, can you still turn the world upside down?

"You damn girl, what did you just do to me?!"

Wang Guixiang roared fiercely, got up on the ground, pointed at Cai Wenji's nose and cursed:

"It's against you! A white-eyed wolf who eats my food and lives in my house actually dares to pretend to be a ghost and scare the elders?!"

"I think you're tired of living! It's a good thing you don't go to the sect's selection today! I'll beat you to death and throw you in a mass grave now, so that you won't stay at home and be an eyesore!"

After scolding, she pounced on her again, raising her hand to tear Cai Wenji's face apart.

In her eyes, this dead girl is just pretending to be mysterious and mysterious. She must be beaten hard before she can continue to be manipulated and oppressed by her husband and wife.

But now Cai Wenji is no longer the weak orphan who was beaten and scolded by her predecessor.

She turned slightly sideways and easily dodged the opponent's crazy attacks. Her figure was light and nimble, completely unlike a frail farm girl who had been working all year round.

At the same time, his thoughts moved slightly, and he no longer controlled and hurt others easily. He only activated a weak healing power, which fell on Wang Guixiang.

[Siwuxie] Slight purification debuff.

Wang Guixiang has always been vicious, angry, and narrow-minded. She is full of turbidity, irritability, and bad energy.

Cai Wenji's healing sound waves have the power to purify and straighten.
